subject: Clarify pricing: dashboards + tracing + extended retention credits
messages:
From: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@orioncloud.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@orioncloud.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 08:14:00 +0100
Subject: Questions on telemetry add-ons pricing and trial credits

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the demo last week — the advanced dashboards and tracing look promising. Procurement is pulling together the commercials for our infra team and we need a couple of clarifications before we proceed to an internal approval: 

- How does Redwood price the observability add-ons (extended retention, tracing ingest, advanced dashboards)? Is it per GB ingested, per trace span, or a seat/license model for dashboards?
- We read about "evaluation credits" in the docs. Can those credits be applied to add-ons, or are they restricted to core API usage?
- If we commit to a 12-month reserved instance for inference, are there bundled discounts for the telemetry add-ons?

I've attached our RFP excerpt with the telemetry section (Orion_RFP_telemetry_2027.pdf). Ideally we want to know a simple set of options (a la carte + two bundled tiers) so we can include costs in the business case.

Would you be able to send a short note that lists concrete line-item pricing and the tradeoffs? Our timeline for budget sign-off is end of next week.

Appreciate it —
Elena Ortiz
Head of Procurement
OrionCloud


From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@orioncloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Questions on telemetry add-ons pricing and trial credits

Elena — thanks for the clear notes and the RFP. Forwarding to pricing and product so we can be precise. Quick summary below while Marissa and Neha align on numbers: 

1) Packaging model (short)
- Extended retention: tiered by retained GB-months (30d, 90d, 365d) with a base per-GB/month plus a small fixed dashboard index fee.
- Tracing ingest: billed on ingest volume (GB/month) with a per-span sample credit for high-cardinality traces; retention follows the same tiered model as logs.
- Advanced dashboards: offered as a per-seat license for editors + a global dashboard compute surcharge (metered) when you exceed interactive query quota.

2) Credits
- Evaluation credits can be applied to all paid Redwood products, including add-ons, for the evaluation period. They are time-limited.

3) Bundles
- We typically offer a Companion Bundle for customers who commit to 12-month reserved inference: 15% off add-on list prices + waived dashboard compute surcharge for the first 90 days. More aggressive discounts are possible with higher commit levels.

Marissa/Neha — please see Elena's timeline (budget sign-off next week) and the attached RFP. Can you propose a concise a la carte price list plus two bundle options (Companion and Enterprise telemetry bundle) with example math? If there's a short PDF or spreadsheet, include it.

Thanks,
Jonas
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
Mobile: +44 7700 900123

Attachment: RDW-pricing-sheet-v3.xlsx (pricing draft)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@orioncloud.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 12:35:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Questions on telemetry add-ons pricing and trial credits

Hi Elena — following up with concrete options. I kept examples small so you can scale them to your expected volumes. Happy to hop on a 20-minute call to walk through the math.

Ala carte (list):
- Extended retention:
  * 30d: $0.08 / GB-month
  * 90d: $0.06 / GB-month
  * 365d: $0.045 / GB-month
  * Dashboard index fee: $250 / month (covers up to 50 dashboards, then $5/dashboard)
- Tracing ingest: $2.50 / GB ingested (sampled spans counted as 0.01 GB/span for billing)
- Advanced dashboards: $50 / editor-seat / month; viewers free (up to 25 viewers), additional viewers $2/viewer/mo above that; interactive compute surcharge: $0.12 / query-minute over included quota

Bundle proposals (assumes 12-month reserved inference commitment):
- Companion Bundle (baseline): 15% off add-on list pricing + 90-day waived compute surcharge for dashboards.
- Enterprise Telemetry Bundle: 25% off add-on list pricing, 180-day waived compute surcharge, and up to $25k in evaluation credits that can be applied to add-ons or core API during the first 90 days.

Credit rules:
- Evaluation credits apply to add-ons and core usage. Credits expire 90 days from issuance unless otherwise negotiated in the MSA.
- Unused credits are not refundable but may be converted into service credits on renewal for committed customers (up to 50% of unused value).

Example (rough math) — if Orion ingests 10 TB/month logs and wants 90d retention + tracing 2 TB/month + 10 editor seats:
- Retention (10 TB = 10,000 GB) at 90d: 10,000 * $0.06 = $600/month
- Tracing ingest (2,000 GB): 2,000 * $2.50 = $5,000/month
- Dashboards: 10 seats * $50 = $500/month + dashboard index fee $250 = $750/month
- Total add-ons list price: ~$6,350/month -> Companion bundle (15% off) => ~$5,397/month

Attached is a redline-friendly term sheet and pricing spreadsheet (terms_redlines.docx and RDW-pricing-sheet-v3.xlsx). If you can share a target committed spend or a preferred bundle, we can draft a tailored commercial and an initial SOW.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
Attachments: terms_redlines.docx, RDW-pricing-sheet-v3.xlsx

Hi Marissa — this is helpful, thank you. A couple of follow-ups from the finance and infra teams: 

1) Credit applicability: the example notes that credits expire in 90 days. Does that 90-day clock start from contract signature or from when credits are issued (we'd prefer issuance date tied to pilot start).
2) Conversion of unused credits: can you confirm the "up to 50%" conversion is a hard cap or negotiable for enterprise deals?
3) Dashboards compute surcharge — can you explain typical query-minute consumption for heavy users? Our infra team is worried about spikes from complex queries and whether the waived quota will be sufficient.

Also, we'd like a 60-day extended trial for advanced dashboards and tracing (not just 30 days) to prove value across a larger sample. Can Redwood extend the waived compute surcharge to 60 days for the Companion Bundle trial?

One more ask: can you provide a very short 1-page example invoice showing monthly charges at the Companion Bundle rate for the example profile you shared? That helps procurement show the cashflow.

Thanks —
Elena

Elena — great questions. Quick answers below and next steps so you can move to internal sign-off this week: 

- Credit start date: credits will start from issuance date tied to pilot activation (we'll document in the SOW). We can confirm activation via a simple onboarding checklist signed by both parties.
- Unused credit conversion: 50% cap is our standard, but for Enterprise bundle deals we can increase that to 75% with a minimum 12-month committed spend threshold. We'll surface that in the redlineable SOW.
- Compute surcharge & heavy queries: typical heavy interactive customers use ~400-900 query-minutes/month per 10 editors, depending on dashboard complexity. The waived quota for Companion Bundle (90 days) is intentionally conservative; for a 60-day extended trial we can waive the surcharge for the full 60 days for the Companion Bundle pilot. For production we'd recommend the Enterprise Bundle if you expect sustained heavy interactive use.

Please find the requested one-page sample invoice below (example Companion Bundle pricing, rounded):
- Retention (90d, 10 TB): $600/month
- Tracing (2 TB ingest): $5,000/month
- Dashboards (10 editor seats + index fee): $750/month
- Subtotal add-ons: $6,350/month
- Companion Bundle 15% discount: -$952.50
- Effective add-ons: $5,397.50/month
- First 60 days waived compute surcharge (applies to dashboard compute only)

Next steps:
1) If Companion Bundle and 60-day trial are acceptable, I'll send a tailored TP (term proposal) and a SOW with activation checklist.
2) We can include a DocuSign link for signature and finalize evaluation credit issuance upon pilot activation.
